messages:
alex: Heads-up — quick-grant flow is adding ~30ms on route-preview RPCs in staging. Not huge but shows up in p95.

maria: Seen it. Any idea which part? permission check vs UI rendering? :thinking:

sam: Traced it yesterday — the expensive bit is the tenant-scope evaluation loop we run sync for every preview call. p95 jumps when scope list > 40.

jamie: Oof. That's the flow where console tries to simulate 'effective perms' per-route right? Users like the instant preview though. :eyes:

alex: Yup. Two options on table: 1) move evaluation to async cache with eventual consistency (fast reads, slight staleness), or 2) add a lightweight fast-path that uses cached bloom-filter token to short-circuit.

ux-ana: From UX: we can tolerate "may be slightly out of date" microcopy if it saves latency. Users prefer snappy UI. Can we show a small badge "stale" when preview uses cached data?

maria: Telemetry ask: if we add cache we need to track when cache hits vs misses, and surface per-tenant miss rate. Sampling at 1% won't cut it for rollouts. Suggest 5% baseline + 100% for canary tenants.

telemetry-bot: perf: route_preview_check p95=150ms (prod sample 2%), errors=0.05%

sam: API-level change proposal: add header `x-perm-preview-mode: fast|accurate|auto`. Default `auto` keeps current behaviour. `fast` uses cache short-circuit, `accurate` does full eval. SDK and Console pass through.

alex: I like explicit header. Internal API debate: is that surface OK for Dedicated/Private customers? We need consistent behavior across deployment modes.

maria: For Dedicated we should default to `accurate` unless customers opt-in. For Hosted, default `auto`. Document in API changelog.

jamie: Rollout plan suggestion: feature flag `quick_grant_fast_path` gated by tenant -> start at 1% tenants, monitor telemetry dashboard for increased mismatch between preview and actual perms (we already have an audit event when preview differs).

ux-ana: I'll craft microcopy: "Preview may be cached; click 'refresh' for latest." Also add a tooltip explaining consistency and how to force accurate evaluation.

sam: Implementation notes: caching key should include tenant-id + scope-hash + role-version. When role or policy changes invalidate key. Invalidation hooks exist on auth service but are coarse today. Need finer-grain.

alex: Telemetry events to add before rollout: `preview.cache_hit`, `preview.cache_miss`, `preview.mode_used`, `preview.stale_warning_shown`, `preview.mismatch_audit`. Include sample_rate on hits/miss (10%) and full for mismatch audits.

maria: I'll add graphs: cache hit ratio over time, preview vs actual mismatch rate, p95 latency by mode. Set alert if mismatch_rate > 0.2% or p95 for fast_path > 250ms.

jamie: Action items: jamie -> update microcopy + small UX indicator (ETA 2 days), sam -> prototype header + cache key (ETA 3 days), alex -> add feature flag + rollout plan in RFC (ETA EOD), maria -> telemetry boards + alerts (ETA 48h).

sam: One more internal API question: do we expose `x-perm-preview-mode` in public SDKs or keep it internal and only used by Console? My vote is expose but behind a beta flag.

alex: Expose but alpha-tag it. Call it out in changelog and SDK docs with warnings.

maria: Agreed. Also need to coordinate with Private deployment docs — they may want to configure defaults via config file.

jamie: Cool — launching the 1% canary next week if telemetry looks sane. :rocket:

ux-ana: Thanks team — I'll drop the microcopy PR and screenshot in #eng-platform when ready.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone sees unexpected perf regressions after canary, ping me and we'll rollback flag.
